name: lt03-mood-artifact-s0

fort.note: Public forts: CLI seeds (docker/task_forts.sh, as runner/yukon/setup.sh). Private forts: pool/dfpool (seeds drawn per season, committed in pool/seasons/<season>/COMMITMENT.json, revealed at close).

pool_note: Private pool (pool/README.md): `snapshot_pool_private` holds placeholders that `pool/dfpool stage` resolves to the season's sealed forts (scenarios/snapshots/<season>-<task>-p<i> under DFBENCH_SNAPSHOTS_DIR); the staged copy drops `snapshot` and replaces `snapshot_pool`. Without staging, the task runs on the public `snapshot_pool` below (competitors' local runs).
description: Seed-built LT03 (docs/SEED-FORTS.md). A working year-1 fort (embark/forts/worked-y1: about 19 dwarves; Carpenters, Still and Kitchen only) where a dwarf is taken by a fey mood to become a legendary wood crafter. The mood needs a Craftsdwarf's workshop (none exists) and one log. Tests reading the need and building the workshop before the dwarf goes insane.
goal: A dwarf has been taken by a strange mood. The artifact must be finished and the dwarf sane and alive at the end (day 45). No dwarf may die.
brief: A dwarf has been taken by a strange mood and wants a workshop to work in.
provenance: Start: embark/forts/worked-y1.json on a fresh TEMPERATE_SOIL embark of each pool seed (embark/make_task_fort.sh), in place of the scripted-y1 snapshot. Setup unchanged from lt03-mood-artifact (mood.lua woodcrafter fey 0). Season-0 copy of scenarios/seed/lt03-mood-artifact.json with the private-pool placeholders.
